column3: Please be advised that as I have already escaped Team Meteor, I have nothing to gain by defending this individual.
Yet, I personally inspected the damage to the PULSE-Camerupt system after the incident there.
Although it was clear that the machine had been targeted by a Fire-Type Attack, there was no significant damage to it from that.
However, the coolant system had been completely drained and removed.
The machine could have powered on, but it would've overheated and shut down long before producing enough energy to resonate with Camerupt.
Further, there was no sign of the Camerupt itself around the scene after the incident.
CAL: It's right here.
CAL: Back then, I used my attack to covertly withdraw the Pokémon from the scene, and have since recovered it back to health.
But that was just a show.
I had discarded the coolant system long beforehand.
The PULSE would've failed regardless, but then you all got involved and Kiki was hurt.
I had to pretend to destroy it myself in order to convince Solaris to drop the operation and retreat before anything else happened.
VICTORIA: That's convenient.
And just how do you explain what happened to her Medicham then?
You still let that poor thing be burnt to a crisp!
CAL: Actually...
VICTORIA: You're not going to say that's the same Medicham.
It sank right into the lava-- there's no way it would have survived that!
CAL: There was another advantage I had discovered when I emptied the PULSE's coolant into the volcano.
Although it didn't visibly impact the surface, the temperature of the lava was lowered significantly.
A human might have been in trouble, but for Pokémon that are used to taking Flamethrowers in the heat of battle...
I was able to rescue it with my Pokémon after you chased me off.
VICTORIA: And you didn't think to bring any of this up before?
CAL: \PN knew some of it.
But you said you didn't want to speak to me.
I intended to respect your wishes for as long as you needed.
VICTORIA: ...
I need to be alone for now.
BENNETT: Awkward.
HARDY: Aye.
BENNETT: Perhaps now would not be the best time to stage a raid on Labradorra after all.
CAL: You're planning to what?
HARDY: We'd been mullin' over the possibility of Bennett here giving the barrier the slip and sticking it to Team Meteor once and for finally all!
EVE: That is IF the others decide he can be trusted.
CAL: I see.
Blake is back there...
But more importantly, Solaris.
Victoria may want nothing to do with me, or she may accept my defense.
But I suspect she will bring her full fury down on him no matter what.
I'll join you, then.
Someone has to look out for her.
LUMI: Then we should wait just a bit, right?
Until we make a decision, and everyone's ready.
BENNETT: Our time is limited until Zero wakes up.
HARDY: Aite, then everyone, just do what you need to for now.
BENNETT: For the sake of not rousing suspicion, I'll just wait here.
Talk to me if you decide you want to go ahead with the plan.
Until everyone's ready.
HARDY: Aite, then everyone, do what you need to, and we'll meet back here with Bennett.
Talk to me whenever you want me to begin.
AMARIA: Oh, hello \PN!
You seem to be doing well!
I've been great!
Nevermind anything that happened before, okay?
It was... just a bad day.
That happens to everyone sometimes, right?
What's important is that we're both here to support everyone in fighting for Reborn!
So, let's give it our all~
AMARIA: That was mildly uncomfortable to overhear.
You seem to make drama wherever you go, don't you?
Oh, no offense meant!
I'm not saying this is all your fault...
But these things just seem to happen around some people more than others.
Like Julia, for instance.
JULIA: Whaaaat!
I've never happened around a drama in my life!
AMARIA: No?
JULIA: Not me!
AMARIA: Not that time you accidentally cheated on that guy with his brother?
JULIA: They were identical twins!
How was I supposed to know!?
AMARIA: Or when you dated that one guy just to make your ex jealous?
JULIA: That was-- wait, which time?
AMARIA: Or when you were head over heels for that one guy who turned out to be a girl?
JULIA: She had a deep voice and a handsome face!
Besides, is that really a problem?
AMARIA: Or that time a guy took you out to dinner and ended up running from the police?
JULIA: He was a smooth-talker...
Not gonna lie, I'd do that again.
That was fun!
AMARIA: Or when you blew up your third boyfriend's studio?
JULIA: Okay-- that one was my fault.
BUT in my defense, they were the ones who left the electrical box open.
I just did what any girl would!
AMARIA: I think I've made my point.
JULIA: Amy!!!!
Rageface, I tell you!!!!
RAGEFACE!!!!
AMARIA: It's not like anyone is ever perfect.
Far from it.
Still, no matter how much drama it is, isn't it better than being alone?
JULIA: Hihi!
I got tired of being tired, so I thought I'd come up here and say "hi"!
The other two are still back at the house moping around though.
Boooooring.
But now I'm here to do my duty ~\nSo let's kick Team Meteor in the booty ~ !
I got tired of being tired, so I thought we'd come up here and say "hi"!
Practically had to pull Amy up with a fishing pole though-- geez!
But now we're here to do our duty ~\nSo let's kick Team Meteor in the booty ~ !
JULIA: Geez, we came up here to help out with Team Meteor and now it's practically turned into a daytime television show!
JULIA: Geez, I came up here to help out with Team Meteor and now it's practically turned into a daytime television show!
Who's the director here?!
Who's the writer!?
I want a word with these people!
And a bigger part!
What's with having no screentime for most of the series, huh?!
I bet they just didn't include me because my upbeat and cheerful personality would ruin the over-serious tone!
And you know what?
They're right!
This is a sitcom now!
We're eating canned laughter for breakfast!
Quick, say something funny!
JULIA: Perfect! You're a natural at this!
Pokéstar Studios, here we come!
VICTORIA: Ever since it happened, I've been beating myself up for ever even having liked Cal.
At this point...
The thought that I might have been wrong to do so is almost more painful than the things I was telling myself.
If I believe him...
Then isn't it our fault Kiki died?
I had always thought I just didn't do enough--
Wasn't strong enough--
But none of that matters.
Strength is weakness aimed at the wrong target.
In the end...
We killed Kiki.
CAL: Maybe I should have been clearer about what happened when we spoke in Obsidia that one time.
That Camerupt had a fever that wouldn't break for seemingly ever.
An effect of the PULSE, no doubt.
And Medicham was a miracle still in progress.
I didn't want to claim to have gotten them out if I wasn't sure they would be well.
And frankly, I was surprised you listened to me for even a second.
I'd be lying if I said that I don't hope Victoria will forgive me,
But that's nothing compared to what it will take for her to forgive herself.
For me to forgive myself.
I don't know if that day ever comes.
HARDY: Not long now, lass...
We'll get you soon.
And if not...
I'mma punch Bennett's face off.
HARDY: Yanno, I'm no fan of anyone who's on Meteor's side of this business,
But the more we wait, the more I think we should go ahead and let that Bennett guy do his thing.
If we don't have another lead, then that's a chance at getting in there to save Aya.
Maybe he dips after all, but we'll never know unless we try.
EVE: It is strange to see him like this.
I'm used to seeing this body in the mirror,
Not on the ground.
I am used to being afraid of myself.
Of what "I" would do to Lumi.
Of what I have done to her.
She has only had half a childhood.
Or a third.
And who knows if she will even get her adulthood.
No, I still have to make sure that she does.
LUMI: If they take Zero back in there...
He probably belongs with Team Meteor,
But then all of you are planning to stop them, right?
Um-- If that happens...
You'd probably end up fighting him again, wouldn't you?
Part of me misses him and part of me never wants to see him again in my life.
But if you do find him...
Could you... at least...
Make sure he gets out alive?
BENNETT: Once you give me the signal, I'll go in there and take that barrier down.
Meteor's precious seconds will be quickly numbered.
Are you ready?
BENNETT: Did you change your mind?
On your word, I'll go in there and take that barrier down.
But that's only if you decide to trust me to do so.
Shall I?
BENNETT: Your word is as good as any for me,
Golden child and all.
Then I'll get started.
BENNETT: I don't know how long it'll take me to get to and deactivate the PULSE.
If I have to do a lot of explaining, it could be a while.
In the meantime, I suggest you make sure everyone else is ready.
But don't worry.
I'll get it done.
CHARLOTTE: How long has it been now?
HARDY: Too long.
LUMI: Do you think something happened...?
SAPHIRA: Nothing unexpected happened.
He was just lying in the first place.
LAURA: I'm sure he wasn't lying!
SAPHIRA: That's what people do, Laura.
They lie,
And cheat,
And hurt others,
And they'll keep doing so until they have no other possible choice.
THAT'S exactly why we have to make that choice for them.
THAT'S why all we have is each other.
THAT'S why I have to look out for you.
You're innocent.
You can be hurt by these kinds of people.
I'll make sure they never hurt you again.
I'll make sure they never hurt anyone again.
RADOMUS: Have you always been this way?
SAPHIRA: Yes.
Ever since I understood what kind of world we lived in,
I've done everything I could to look out for my sisters.
My job's not done yet.
But it will be soon.
RADOMUS: And how about before then?
Before you understood, that is.
SAPHIRA: That's...
When I was naive.
Innocent.
Back then, that's not--
That wasn't who I am.
LAURA: After Mom and Dad passed away, she was really unstable.
SAPHIRA: You don't need to bring that up.
CHARLOTTE: I remember that time you punched that one girl--
The only one who was in the Circuit more than you were-- what was her name again?
But you slugged her and then just started bawling.
LAURA: That happened more than once.
CHARLOTTE: But you don't cry anymore, huh.
SAPHIRA: There's nothing to cry about.
I just need to solve the problem.
Put them in their place.
RADOMUS: But it sounds like you changed, after all.
SAPHIRA: So what?
RADOMUS: If you can change, what's to say that others can't?
In my opinion, you underestimate others.
SAPHIRA: Sorry if my life hasn't been so chock full of fairy tales and fantasies as yours has.
We don't all get the privilege to stay soft.
RADOMUS: And yet, you have a responsibility that sheer cynicism cannot fulfill for you.
The best moves often require not only trust in others, but also...
SAPHIRA: But also what?
RADOMUS: Patience.
RADOMUS: Shall we be off?
The endgame awaits us.
LAURA: Do you see now?
Bennett really was telling the truth.
He's on our side.
SAPHIRA: We'll see about that.
But for right now...
I have an appointment with the doctor.
LAURA: Fine.
If no one else is going to look out for him, then I will.
HARDY: That's a sentiment I can echo.
Let's go, Aya! I'm comin' for ya!
LUMI: Um!
Eve, I'm worried about Zero.
EVE: Then you'll have to find him.
LUMI: You're not coming?
EVE: No, I can't be there to hold your hand this time.
I'm going to do what I can about the PULSE Pokémon still in there.
Whoever fights them will need to be prepared.
This might be one of the precious few ways I can still unravel the things I've done.
LUMI: ...Yeah, okay!
I don't need hand-holding anyway by now.
We'll do what we've never been able to before--
Divide and conquer!
JULIA: C'mon, c'mon already!
JULIA: They need all the help they can get, right?
And what better help than tactical explosion support!
AMARIA: Oh, sure.
AMARIA: I look forward to fighting alongside you, \PN.
CHARLOTTE: I like the peppy one.
JULIA: All right, all right, let's go to war ~ !
Cuz staying here'd be a huge bore ~ !
JULIA: I wonder how much stuff I can blow up before they catch me!
CHARLOTTE: I like her.
CHARLOTTE: Well, I'd better not miss the fun.
Just remember, if you see any buildings on fire up there,
It tooooootally wasn't me.
CAL: She's after Solaris, no doubt.
Well, I guess I'm in for her.
And however many other dozens of reasons I have to judge myself.
NOEL: You can go ahead.
I... don't need to go.
BENNETT: Just as well.
This isn't a moment to take lightly.
I'll be here when you're ready to begin.
BENNETT: Fine.
You're free to search for another solution, but I wouldn't be sure that one exists.
Locked.

FLORA: Okay, this one's in a lot better shape, although...
That laser attachment is weird.
FLORA: So this is a real, actual PULSE, huh...
Do they always have that big laser attachment?
Might ruin some things, but I can't complain.
Listen, this is gonna take some time. Please standby.
FLORA: Huh?
FLORA: \PN, have you seen the Pokémon that was placed within this PULSE?
FLORA: I see... So this was home for a Clawitzer at a certain point in time.
The laser attachment here is perfectly suited for Clawitzer's giant claw.
I assume the energy from this machine allowed Clawitzer to blast out gigantic beams of laser energy?
The amount of power needed to do that would surely put the Pokémon in agony. Without a doubt.
Disgusting.
Humans deserve whatever comes their way, but Pokémon are innocent.
And just look what it was forced to do.
FLORA: Would you just take a look at this place?
Just completely thrashed and trashed, and thrown all away into nothing.
Does that not disturb you?
The people in power of this region were powerless to do anything about it.
They just sat there and watched as this city crumbled, because that's all their weak asses could do.
FLORA: But I'm not going to bore you with that.
After all, you know where all of these PULSE machines have been.
You've seen them all in action, haven't you, \PN?
FLORA: Hah, I don't even need a verbal response for this one.
Your eyes have said it all in one flash.
Um, well...
I'm done here, okay.
The laser attachment added too many different variables that aren't helpful to me.
FLORA: \PN, would you please bring me to another one? Pretty please?
FLORA: Yay! \PN! You're my hero!
FLORA: Pretty, pretty please!!
I just need to see a few more, kay?
Just a few more and that'd be enough for me, I promise!
(Tch... You're getting annoying with this, \PN. Just do what you're asked.)
Okay, well, where is the next PULSE?
FLORA: ...
\PN, I've been wondering this for a minute, but...
Could it possibly be the case that you are, perhaps, just the teensiest bit,
COMPLETELY MORONIC?!
We were JUST at Devon where the Magnezone was!
REMEMBER?!
We had to travel ALL THAT WAY FOR NOTHING?!
Does that RING A BELL or is there nothing in the space between your ears to even notice?!
When I turn around again, we're going to pretend like you DIDN'T just suggest traveling halfway across the region to look at the trash heap you already took me to once.
Okay?
Okay.
Three, two, one...
Okay, \PN. Where is the next PULSE?
Uh-huh...
So, we're going to head off to the Devon Co.  building?
That's... far!
Guess that's okay though. This should be totally worth it in the end!
Shall we go together?
FLORA: Let's be off then, \PN!
FLORA: Um, okay!
I don't know where the Devon building is so this is actually really inconvenient for me!
But I'm good with directions.
I should be able to find it on my own!
Haha!
(What an inconvenient pest...)
FLORA: Hm... So there are two in this area then?
If the one here has an attachment, then it's pretty likely that the other one would have one as well...
But I guess it can't hurt to check.
Okay, \PN, take me to the next machine.
Locked.
